record.reason: Ray is a general-purpose distributed framework for interactive AI applications. The paper's conclusion notes a training/serving/simulation loop, but the motivating applications and reported evaluation focus on reinforcement-learning workloads and distributed task throughput (up to 1.8 million tasks/s), not LLM inference or LLM-serving efficiency. General framework applicability alone does not establish the required LLM-inference focus, so this is unrelated to the assigned scope.
record.title: Ray: A Distributed Framework for Emerging AI Applications
